name: movie_epstau_isi_line
label: Movie: epsilon Tau on the three ISI trucks in a line at 650 nm, three baselines a night, six nights
notes: The third truck: three telescopes in an East-West line at spacings (a, b) measure the baselines a, b and a + b in the same night, so each night samples three points of |V|^2(B). The schedule 25+35, 35+40, 45+50 m (baselines 25/35/60, 35/40/75, 45/50/95 m), twice, brackets the 63 m null and reaches the first sidelobe: 2.2 % on the diameter in six nights against 4.0 % for nine nights of the pair.
Limb darkening stays out of reach: the sidelobe at |V|^2 ~ 0.01 against the per-night sigma gives sigma(u) ~ 3.5 after the six nights; ~2000 nights would be needed for 0.1.
